LightningComponentBundle.description: Customer intelligence dashboard with support cases and financial portfolio. All data fields can be overridden for demos.

property.name: accentColor
property.label: Accent Color
property.description: Hex color for accents. Defaults to SLDS brand blue.

property.name: backgroundImage
property.label: Banner Image URL
property.description: URL for the banner image at top of card.

property.name: tierLabel
property.label: Tier Label
property.description: Customer tier badge (e.g. Platinum, Gold). Leave empty to hide.

property.name: memberSince
property.label: Member Since
property.description: Override member since year (e.g. 2019). Leave empty to use record data.

property.name: overrideOpenCases
property.label: Override Open Cases
property.description: Override the open case count for demos. Leave empty for live data.

property.name: overrideHighPriorityCases
property.label: Override High Priority Cases
property.description: Override high priority case count for demos. Leave empty for live data.

property.name: overrideCasesJson
property.label: Override Cases (JSON)
property.description: JSON array of cases for demos. Example: [{"id":"1","caseNumber":"00001","subject":"Login issue","status":"New","priority":"High","isOpen":true}]. Leave empty for live data.

property.name: overrideLoansJson
property.label: Override Loans (JSON)
property.description: JSON array of loans for demos. Example: [{"id":"1","loanType":"Mortgage","interestRate":5.25,"originalAmount":400000,"currentBalance":350000}]. Leave empty for live data.
